primary_route: Activity-defined DG population manipulated during acquisition; subsequent no-light context-specific behavior, physiological recruitment and contingency controls.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation and transfer verification of original tagging, optical activation and behavioral Methods/supplements or validated protocols.

checks.quote: dox washout to re‑enable TRE control
checks.reason: The timeline says doxycycline washout ensures no new tagging, whereas c-fos-tTA/TRE is suppressed by doxycycline and enabled after its removal. The main tagging paragraph correctly restores doxycycline; this contradictory timeline instruction requires correction. Primary source: https://www.its.caltech.edu/~jkenny/nb250c/papers/Liu-2012.pdf .

checks.quote: train duration matched to shock epochs
checks.reason: No executable expression/delivery interval validation, count/duration of acquisition pairings or operational unpaired separation is specified. Optical and shock examples alone do not complete the intervention schedule.

Physiology, anatomy and blinded scoring validation are planned, but objective measurement-calibration acceptance criteria or a procedure deriving them, including scorer agreement/dynamic range and failure action, are not operationally specified.
A minimum bout is proposed, but test duration/primary time denominator and movement-threshold calibration-to-choice or missing-frame rules remain unspecified.
Technical exclusions are blinded, but there is no full assigned-animal sensitivity analysis, missing-outcome policy and maximum replacement/stopping rule retaining all denominators.
The primary interaction/contrasts are identified, but the bounded-outcome model/interval method and multiplicity procedure remain future choices rather than an operational inferential specification.
Independent pilots and a subsequent lock are proposed, but the power/labeling/physiological parameter exploration lacks a complete bounded search and objective selection/stop rule.
No explicit failure-triggered revision specifies what remains fixed, refreezes the changed procedure and obtains fresh independent confirmation after troubleshooting.

Light-only expression after training does not uniquely identify conditioning to photostimulation; incomplete natural-context recruitment or state-dependent retrieval can also explain it. The supportive rule should explicitly require the measured A-versus-D specificity, not merely paired/A versus between-group controls.
No complete animal/construct/batch-to-raw-video/event/physiology/histology manifest with actual delivery records and analysis versions/settings sufficient for reconstruction.

historical_match_reason: All five are present in the clearly stated primary route: neutral A representation as a conditionable stimulus; new association rather than acute output; neutral A tagging followed by pairing in C; no-light natural A plus novel D and unpaired/inactive controls; context-A-specific learned freezing predicted explicitly. The main paragraph restores doxycycline and calls for a closed window, so the later washout wording error is deducted under G1 without pretending the intended route is fear-tagging or erasing all matching components. Round-one hit retained.
